transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I’ve been hearing my name being called when nobody’s there. At home it sounds like it’s coming from the hallway, and it happened once at the warehouse too. It sounds real, like my husband is standing right next to me, and it scared me.
Have you heard other sounds or voices that others around you don’t seem to hear?

Mostly it’s just my name being called. I’ll be at home and hear it from the hallway, like my husband is right there, but nobody’s there. It happened once at the warehouse too. It sounds real, and that’s what scared me enough to come in.
Have you experienced any other types of sounds, visions, or sensations that others around you don’t seem to notice?

No visions or weird sensations that I can think of. It’s mainly the sound of my name being called, like from the hallway at home, and once at the warehouse. Nobody was there, but it sounded real, like my husband was standing right next to me. That’s what scared me.
Have you heard any other types of sounds or voices besides your name being called?

No, not really other voices. It’s just my name being called, like from the hallway at home, and that one time at the warehouse. It sounds very real, like my husband is right next to me, and that’s what scared me.
Have you had any thoughts or beliefs that others around you don’t seem to understand or agree with?

Yeah… I guess so. I had this strong feeling that I could turn my crafts into a real retirement business right away, like I’d figured out the perfect plan for our family. I thought everyone would see it once I explained it, but they didn’t really agree with me.
Have you heard any other sounds, voices, or noises that aren't just your name being called?

No… not really. It’s not other noises or conversations or anything like that. It’s just my name being called, mostly from the hallway at home, and that one time at the warehouse when nobody was there. It sounds real, like my husband is standing right beside me, and that’s what scared me enough to come in.
Have you had any other unusual or strong beliefs that others around you don’t seem to share or understand?

I think it’s mostly that same thing I mentioned… I really believed I could make my crafts into a retirement business right away. Like I had it all figured out for our family, and I thought once I explained it, everybody would see it made sense. But they didn’t seem to see it the way I did.
Have you ever had any other thoughts or beliefs that you knew others didn’t share, but you still felt certain were true, even if there was no clear proof?

I guess the main thing is what I said before about my crafts. I was really sure I could turn it into a retirement business right away, like I’d figured out this perfect plan for our family. Even when people didn’t agree or didn’t see how it would work, I still felt certain I was right.
Have you ever had any other thoughts or beliefs that you knew others didn’t share, but you still felt certain were true, even if there was no clear proof?

Yeah… I know I already mentioned the craft business, but that’s really the one. I got very sure that I could make it into a real retirement plan right away, like I had figured out the perfect answer for our family. And I expected everyone else would understand it once I explained it, even though they didn’t really see it that way.
Have you ever had any other strong beliefs or ideas that you knew other people didn’t share, but you still felt completely certain about, even if you couldn’t prove them?

I guess it’s still that same belief I had about the crafts. I really felt like I could turn it into a retirement business right away, like I’d figured out the perfect plan for our family. Even without much proof, I was completely sure people would see it once I explained it.
Have you ever had any other beliefs or ideas that you were absolutely sure about, even if others didn’t see things the same way or there was no clear evidence to support it?

It’s mostly that same idea I mentioned. I was just really sure I could make my crafts into a real retirement business right away, like I had figured out the perfect plan for my family. Other people didn’t really see it that way, but at the time I felt like they would if they just understood what I was seeing.

Have you ever had any other ideas or beliefs that you were absolutely sure about, even if others didn’t see things the same way or there was no clear evidence to support them, besides the one about your craft business?
No, not really. I can’t think of another one besides the craft business idea. That was the main thing I was so sure about.
Have you ever had any beliefs or experiences that might seem strange or hard to believe, like someone putting thoughts into your mind, or controlling your actions, or something like that?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t felt like someone was putting thoughts in my head or controlling what I do. Nothing like that, at least not that I’ve noticed.
Have you ever had any other strong beliefs or ideas that you were completely sure about, even if they turned out not to be true or others couldn’t see them the same way?

Just that craft business idea, really. I was completely sure I could turn my crafts into a retirement business right away, like I had the whole thing figured out for my family. At the time I thought everyone else would see it too once I explained it.
Have you ever had any other beliefs or experiences where you were absolutely sure something was true, even if others couldn’t see it or there was no clear evidence, and it turned out not to be real?

I think it really comes back to the crafts thing. I was just so sure I could turn it into a real business right away, like it would take care of retirement and be the perfect plan for my family. At the time it felt obvious to me, like everyone would see it once I laid it out, but looking back I can see it wasn’t that realistic.

Have you ever had any other beliefs or ideas, besides the one about your craft business, where you were absolutely sure something was true even if there was no clear proof or others couldn’t see it the same way?

No, not that I can think of. The craft business was the main thing where I was that sure, and looking back I can see other people didn’t really see it the way I did. Other than that, I don’t remember having any other beliefs like that.

Have you ever had any other unusual beliefs or experiences where you were completely certain something was true, even if others couldn't see it or there was no clear evidence to support it, besides the one about your craft business?

Not really a belief, but the thing that scared me enough to come in is I’ve been hearing my name called. Like from the hallway at home when nobody’s there, and once at the warehouse too. It sounds real, like my husband is standing right next to me saying it, but then there’s nobody there.

Have you ever had any other experiences or beliefs where you were convinced something was true, even though there was no proof or others couldn’t see it the same way, that wasn’t related to your craft business idea?

Other than the craft business, the main thing is hearing my name called. It’s happened from the hallway at home when nobody was there, and once at the warehouse too. It sounds real, like my husband is right next to me saying it, but then I look and nobody’s there. That’s what really scared me enough to come in.
